findings.title: The central optimism proof substitutes a strictly larger correction bonus
findings.location: Theorem 3.2 p.3; Appendix F p.35; Lemma F.1 p.37; Eq.(74) p.40 and cancellation p.41
findings.source_claim: For L=log(5HSAT/delta), b'(y)=min{84^2 H^3 S^2 A L^2/max(1,N'_{k,h+1}(y)),H^2}, the theorem's correction is C=sqrt(4 E_Phat[b']/max(N_k(x,a),1)). Lemma F.1 also omits an exterior factor L, but places the minimum outside the expectation.
findings.suspect_step: Eq.(74) inserts an additional exterior L inside the correction square root, using sqrt(L)*C, which the following cancellation requires.

complete_check.kind: Admissible algorithm execution falsifying the intermediate proof inequality

mdp.transitions: Both actions return deterministically to the sole state
mdp.policy: Episode 1 uses a0 at both stages; subsequent episodes use a1 at stage 1 and a0 at stage 2

assumptions: Legal greedy tie choices and monotone Q clipping
Terminal bonus zero as footnote 5 specifies
Transition and martingale errors vanish; event E holds deterministically
True values zero and estimated values nonnegative, so optimism holds
Sole-state probability distribution supplies consistent zero-count convention
complete_check.execution_verification: Closed-form greedy comparisons checked through 100000 episodes by an independent reviewer script; no author code executed

alternatives_counterevidence: The main theorem, repeated lemma correction and released correction all omit the extra exterior L; L^2 within b' does not absorb it
The cap is active in a one-state MDP, so H^2/H^3 variants and minimum/expectation placement do not change the witness
The future gap is zero, so retaining that nonnegative term cannot rescue the inequality
Azar 2017 contains a related inherited missing-L variance-bound step; historical lineage is explicitly recorded
findings.dependency_and_impact: Lemma F.1 provides optimism needed to connect actual regret to the central surrogate bound. A demonstrated false inequality in this core derivation supports Major under the specified severity rule. Neither nonoptimism nor falsity of the final regret theorem is established.

repair.proposed: Prove the result for the stated correction, or add L to the algorithm and rederive its bonus sum and final constants
repair.verified: Only the local substitution mismatch and full witness are verified
repair.not_verified: No complete repaired algorithm or theorem

findings.title: Invalid reciprocal-root summation constants in the central regret derivations
findings.location: D.7 p.25 after Eq.(34); D.9 pp.30-31 Eqs.(56)-(57); Appendix E pp.34-35
findings.source_claim: D.7/D.9 convert displayed reciprocal-root sums using constants that require sum_{n=1}^N n^(-1/2)<=sqrt(N)/2; Appendix E effectively uses <=sqrt(N). Appendix E also sums 2H*sqrt(L/N) where Theorem 3.1 states 2HL/sqrt(N).

complete_check.analytic: For every N>=1, sum n^(-1/2)>=sqrt(N)>sqrt(N)/2, with the first inequality strict for N>1.
complete_check.scope: This is a counterexample to the displayed scalar inequality; it does not assert a stochastic variance attains the sum or disprove D.7's final lemma statement.

findings.dependency_and_impact: D.7 feeds D.9, which feeds Appendix F Eq.(75) and the central 24e/616e constants. The errors also occur in the CH proof. Invalid constant-sensitive core derivations support Major; no final regret coefficient is declared false merely from these steps.

repair.verified_local: sum n^(-1/2)<=2*sqrt(N)-1<=2*sqrt(N). Under the displayed reindexing, D.7 coefficients 1+4+2 become 4+4+8, giving conservative 16 instead of 7.
repair.partial_slack: Conditional on other counting steps, normalized Eq.(51) envelope with 16 is 1+2/sqrt(250)+4/(3*250)+16/sqrt(250)=2.14375329<4. Corrected CH coarse envelope 4HL*sqrt(SAT)+8H*sqrt(SATL) fits 10HL*sqrt(SAT) for H>=2 and L>=log(20).
repair.not_verified: A complete repaired probabilistic proof or final theorem; stage-counter aggregation and differing H powers still require reconciliation.

alternatives_counterevidence: Existing downstream slack can absorb some corrected coefficients; no blanket claim that all final constants must increase
D.9 stage-specific harmonic sums cannot simply be pooled without the stage index, but the final H^2 correction may absorb that factor
F Eq.(70)-(71) has threshold-scale algebra concerns for which the cap offers a possible repair; not counted as a separate theorem failure

findings.title: Official released implementation computes the wrong probability-weighted variance and differs from the displayed algorithm
findings.location: Pinned official repo agents.py:78-84,215-217 and related initialization/bonus lines

complete_check.uniform_probability_scaling: Released variance equals the required variance divided by S^2; the corresponding square-root bonus component is divided by S.

other_differences: Terminal UCBVI bonus remains positive and terminal stage-count slot is not updated, contrary to footnote 5
Q initialization/cap H at all stages differs from H-h+1 in Algorithm 1
UCBVI L=log(5SAKH) omits theorem's extra H/delta factor and exposes no delta argument
CH improved=True receives coefficient 7, while False receives refined coefficient 2
alternatives_counterevidence: BF/BFI constants 8,14,100^2 versus 4,7,84^2 match the formulas
Old Azar algorithm explains the constant H cap but does not establish agreement with the displayed 2025 algorithm
Shared differences across BF variants prevent inferring their comparative performance effect
findings.dependency_and_impact: Confirmed released artifact mismatch. The numerical effect on the paper's curves, rankings or ratio remains Needs Evidence; no empirical effect is invented. Minor applies to the demonstrated code/document correspondence issue.

repair.not_verified: No author code edited, executed or benchmarked; complete implementation repair and performance comparison not validated
